Informational Video for Emergency Preparedness and Safety in Seoul
Emergency Preparedness and Safety in Seoul — Video Transcript
STAY SAFE IN SEOUL
An emergency? Don’t be alarmed by the sirens.
Check the app to find out what’s happening. It’s just a civil defense drill! *Drills to prepare for national emergencies or air raids
Get real-time emergency alerts and information with Emergency Ready App.
We’ll help keep you safe on your way home. Safe Return Home Monitoring on the Ansimi App
Walk your dog. Help keep your neighborhood safe. Dog Patrol Program
Help keep your neighborhood safe on the go. Seoul Running Patrols
Call the 120 Dasan Call Center before you go. 24-Hour Hospitals and Pharmacies
In an emergency, call 119.
For police assistance, call 112.
For information about living in Seoul, call 120.
For tourism and interpretation services, call 1330.
Report Unfair Taxi Fares
Safety First, Seoul!
Don’t panic! Stay safe in Seoul.
– The Ministry of the Interior and Safety provides prompt and accurate disaster information in 22 languages, including English, Chinese, and Japanese, to help ensure the safety of foreign nationals residing in Korea.

(free)
*

(Configuration) Select your region, disaster alert settings, and language
*
*
